svg.text: Idle sawmill: the plank saw (row 2), four ideas (idle, three frames of work in a loop, done)
a boxed frame; three blades stacked over each other saw back and forth (they shift between frames), a crank wheel on top; the cant goes in as one block, four boards come out
a pillar with three big flat discs sticking out over the lane like a stack of plates; the cant is pushed between them and splits into four boards
three flat band loops on big wheels, one above the other, each blade at a cutting height; the teeth run along the blade; the most "real sawmill" look
D One blade, one board at a time
the sibling of the log saw: one big flat disc, the cant slides through; boards pile up on a rack by the machine
